title: A simple grounding sequence
intro: A three-minute practice for returning from a heavy moment to the room you are in.

sections.heading: Name five things
sections.body: Use your senses to reconnect with the present.

sections.heading: Slow the exhale
sections.body: Let the out-breath become a little longer than the in-breath.

sections.heading: Choose one action
sections.body: Drink water, step outside, or message someone you trust.
